label: prop:derived-mass-formula-light-isotopes
title: Derived-only mass formula reproduces light atomic masses to sub-percent
html:
The strict derived mass formula

\begin{aligned}
\mathfrak{m}(Z, N) &= Z \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{p}} + N \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}} + Z m_e \\
                  &\quad + \alpha \bigl(\Phi_1 - 2[3]_q \Phi_2 + h_{\mathrm{A}}^2 \Phi_3\bigr) \\
                  &\quad + \Delta_{W}(Z, N) + \Delta_{T=1}(Z, N)
\end{aligned}

with each term derived (no fitting):

  • \alpha = m_e \cdot 8G (Borromean prefactor; binding scale);
  • \Phi_1, \Phi_2, \Phi_3 extracted from per-generator transfer-matrix chains using only the inter-nucleon generators (positions 3k+2 for k = 0, \ldots, A{-}2);
  • \Delta_W = -m_e \cdot H_q((2,2)) \cdot \min(Z, N)/A (Wigner T=0 pn pairing, Wigner np pairing);
  • \Delta_{T=1} = -m_e \cdot H_q((2,2)) \cdot (n_{pp} + n_{nn})/A (natural T=1 isovector extension using the same self-conjugate partition (2,2) \vdash 4 and the same 1/A normalisation, with n_{pp} = Z(Z{-}1)/2 and n_{nn} = N(N{-}1)/2);

reproduces the atomic masses of all isotopes from \mathfrak{p} through ^7Li to sub-percent accuracy.

The categorical scorecard, the proton-neutron mass splitting, and the binding under-prediction pattern are collected in the derived-mass-formula scorecard.
